source: Harpoon V 2026 §4.6.4.1 PDF36 printed4-4; China's Navy 2025 PDF10/A-3 explicitly lists arresting gear for Type001/002/003. America's Navy 2025 PDF7-8/A-4/A-5 Ford/Nimitz conventional carrier decks. Source-backed capability guard supplements configured wing and capacity checks.
